walk_meta.subtitle: Kap Karoso Farm & Culture Walk · West Sumba
walk_meta.excerpt: A morning at the Kap Karoso farm — composting, chicken houses, Japanese cucumbers and breadfruit trees — followed by an introduction to Sumbanese culture: the Marapu animist religion, the Pasola horse-fighting festival, the enormous bride price in buffalo, and the ceremony of the sea worms.
